summary: No new sense or stem is justified by these three occurrences. Preserve I begatten, beschlafen and II schänden as inherited.

PrS 19/5 has I Preterit ʕmile with overt l Ḥamzo as agent and ʕam-partner aʕma. This differs in argument coding from the object suffix -la in I Infectum gʕomela at 101/17, without proving a new meaning.
II mʕamewayli at 107/121 carries a counterfactual wish, not an asserted completed violation. German hätte does not justify moving it from Infectum-wa.
The surface ʕome-la can absorb final root l; no new root is inferred from the spelling. The Preterit base is already given, but no trustworthy aligned German example is available in this input.

Retrieve and verify the German ending of PrS 19/4 against the Turoyo opening of 19/5 before adding the missing Preterit box example; the current verse translation begins with the murder plot and omits the target clause.
Confirm whether ʕam-partner versus pronominal object coding correlates with dialect, reciprocity or discourse; one instance of each does not establish a construction contrast.
